Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.title: Schweinekotelett with Zwetschgen, mustard and buttered Spätzle
Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.pitch: Plums collapsed right in the pan juices with coarse mustard and fresh thyme. Rich, sweet-tart pan sauce over tender, butter-tossed Spätzle.

Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.title: Pork chops with balsamic plums, crisp sage and soft polenta
Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.pitch: Fresh sage leaves crackled in foaming butter, plums caramelized with a splash of balsamic into a glossy glaze. Spooned over warm, creamy polenta.

Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.title: Cantonese plum-glazed chops with ginger and Shaoxing wine
Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.pitch: Chops seared hard, then deglazed with Shaoxing wine and simmered in plums, soy, and fresh ginger until glossy and sticky. Steamed jasmine rice to soak it up.

Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.title: Chuletas con ciruela: pork chops with smoky chipotle plum glaze
Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Jammy Zwetsch.pitch: Plums melted down in the pan with chipotle in adobo, a pinch of Mexican oregano, and fresh lime. Sweet, smoky heat clinging to the chops, warm corn tortillas on the side.
